direction: Conversational research workspace with a Jarvis-style command bar, contextual evidence panels and continuous spatial transitions.

recommended_foundation.name: assistant-ui
recommended_foundation.fit: React assistant primitives, streaming and custom tool-result components. Use our experiment and comparison tools to navigate the existing research JSON.
recommended_foundation.scope: Frontend foundation. A model backend and our data tools still need to be connected.

proposed_behavior: 280-420 ms panel glides with restrained spring settling.
Keep a selected evidence card visually continuous as it expands into a comparison.
Use transform and opacity for the main movement; briefly apply a small blur to a moving panel, then restore crisp text.
Profile animation alongside the 3D scene on the target laptop. Reduce effects if the frame budget is exceeded.
Provide reduced-motion behavior and keep clicks responsive while previous transitions finish.

first_interaction_to_prototype.prompt: Compare Ultem on the Moon and Mars
flow: The prompt bar settles into its dock.
Jarvis selects the Ultem evidence and opens the two published cases.
Two comparison panels glide into the research canvas.
A source control opens the original paper and test definitions.
Return to scene carries the existing selected object and destination IDs.

attribution: Designs are visual references by their credited creators. No design assets or repository code were copied into the app during this research step.
